title: ne -- Android Pixel Device Test and Play Store Submission
description:
Took the Android app from internal-testing-ready to submitted for Play production review. Enabled R8 (proguard-rules.pro was referenced by build.gradle.kts but did not exist; persistence uses kotlinx.serialization's JSON tree API with hand-written fromJson/toJson, so there are no generated serializers to strip) and verified the release APK on-device: fresh install shows defaults with no panel open (SeedPolicy.REQUIRE_PROVENANCE holds on a non-debuggable build) and counters survive force-stop then relaunch. Generated the full Play asset set from gen_assets.py so both stores share one generator: 512x512 icon rendered from the SAME artwork as the iOS icon (plus mark and the four counter dots), 1024x500 feature graphic supersampled 4x, five 1080x2400 phone screenshots, plus 7-inch and 10-inch tablet screenshots. Wrote playstore listing.md, README.md, whatsnew and a paste-ready PLAY_LISTING_COPY.txt adapted from the App Store copy. Built .github/workflows/play-release.yml (track selector, staged rollout, mapping.txt upload, draft-release support) and retired play-internal.yml. Uploaded versionCode 110003 as a draft production release; the user completed the Console work and submitted for review.

Four defects were found and fixed along the way, three of them only visible because the work forced real rendering: (1) .codeyam/stack.json declared no simulator.androidPackage, so the editor launched com.codeyam.android -- stale since applicationId became com.codeyam.counter -- which meant scenario seeding wrote to the wrong shared_prefs file and silently captured ambient state instead of the seed; (2) themes.xml was still parented on Theme.Material.LIGHT.NoActionBar, so every cold start flashed white before the near-black app drew (the plan recorded this fix as done, but it had never landed -- it surfaced as an all-white capture frame); (3) the app had no tablet layout -- the hero numeral stranded against the left edge with half the screen empty -- now capped by MaxContentWidth at 480dp and centred, inert on every phone; (4) AppSettingsPanelInteractionTest sat in the variant-agnostic src/test/ while depending on the debugImplementation-scoped ui-test-manifest AAR, so testReleaseUnitTest ran a test whose host activity structurally cannot exist on that variant -- moved to src/testDebug/, and gradlew test is now green on both variants (debug 171, release 169) with release coverage retained. Also registered 5 Android tests that had never been in the registry.

CI versioning was reworked after a failed production dispatch exposed two bugs: userFraction was computed with the `cond && A || B` ternary, which cannot express 'omit this input' (the empty true-branch is falsy, so it fell through and sent the rollout value), and both workflows derived versionCode from `100000 + run_number` -- per-workflow counters that duly collided. Fixed by splitting the upload into three mutually exclusive steps (draft / full / staged) and, structurally, by deleting play-internal.yml so a single uploader makes the run number a safe monotonic counter.

Store assets were also moved out of .codeyam/store/ to a visible top-level store/, since macOS hides dot-directories and these are assets a human uploads by hand.
